Card Q&A.q: 2 copies of this Digimon are deleted at the same time, and their [On Deletion] effects triggered simultaneously. Can I play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text when the 1st effect activates, then use the 2nd effect to play a Tamer card with the same name as the Tamer card played by the 1st effect?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Trash 2 purple cards among them. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[On Deletion] From your trash and without paying the cost, you may play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text and without the same name as any of your Tamers.
